The '''Savage Slayers''' were a group of [[Gormak]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] on [[Voss]]. Based at [[Gorma-Koss]] in [[Gormak Lands]], these Gormak were able to draw strength from their tame [[Ssorokk|cyberbeasts]], becoming nearly unstoppable, until Republic-allied individuals eventually wiped them out on behalf of [[Voss commandos]].<ref name="Savage Connections" />
